summary: Iteration 22 - Energy Monitoring feature testing completed. Backend: 11/12 tests passed (1 skipped). Frontend: All UI tests passed. Energy monitoring dashboard, detail pages with charts, and admin permissions UI all functioning correctly.

minor.issue: Some older users (created before energy_monitoring feature) don't have energy_monitoring in their apps object. The backend handles this correctly with get_default_apps(), but frontend admin table shows N/A for these users.

hub_page_energy_button.test: Hub page shows Energy Monitoring button for admin users
hub_page_energy_button.result: Button present with amber Zap icon and correct description

energy_monitoring_dashboard.test: Energy Monitoring dashboard at /energy-monitoring loads Messkoffer devices
energy_monitoring_dashboard.result: Shows 2 Messkoffer devices with stats cards (total devices, online count, kW total, kWh import)

energy_monitoring_detail_page.result: Shows 5 charts (Power, Voltage, Current, Energy Import, Frequency) with 1434+ data points

energy_monitoring_metrics.result: 6 metric cards showing Leistung (6.94 kW), Spannung (229.2 V), Strom (30.31 A), Frequenz (50.1 Hz), Energie Import (281.5 kWh), Cos Phi (0.96)

admin_energy_column.test: Admin user table shows Energy column
admin_energy_column.result: ENERGY column visible showing 'Nicht aktiv' status for kunde users

admin_energy_monitoring_permissions.test: Admin user edit modal shows Energy Monitoring permission section
admin_energy_monitoring_permissions.result: Energy Monitoring toggle present with Zap icon in App-Berechtigungen section

api_devices_list.result: Returns array with device details including meter_count and latest_data

api_device_detail.result: Returns device details including meters array

api_telemetry.result: Returns array of telemetry records with EMU data fields

api_telemetry_latest.result: Returns array with meter info and latest telemetry per meter

api_permission_blocking.result: kunde@test.com correctly blocked with 'Energy Monitoring nicht freigeschaltet'

api_admin_update_permissions.test: Admin can update user energy_monitoring permissions via PUT /api/users/:id
api_admin_update_permissions.result: Successfully updates enabled, access_all, device_ids, access_type, access_start, access_end fields

api_seed_demo_data.result: Endpoint works, returns message about existing demo data

seed_data_creation: Demo telemetry data already seeded for MK-001 device (1440+ records)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 22 complete. Energy Monitoring feature fully tested. Two Messkoffer devices exist: 'Messkoffer 001' (offline, no data) and 'Messkoffer Baustelle A / MK-001' (online, has demo telemetry data). Admin permissions UI includes: enabled toggle, access_all toggle, individual device selection, and time-based access (permanent/temporary with date range) for Kunde users. The telemetry data is MOCKED/DEMO data, not from real EMU meters.

mocked_apis_list: Telemetry data is seeded demo data, not real EMU meter readings
